name_reason: Convention-compliant: data_fd2_<domain=ui>_<descriptor>. Descriptor 'terrain_hud_user_enabled' correctly reflects both the data shape (boolean enable flag) and the purpose (user-controlled toggle for the terrain-info HUD). No Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix). Domain 'ui' is right (menu option + HUD render gate). No numeric domain ID involved.
purpose: Per-save user toggle (boolean) that enables/disables the cursor terrain-info HUD overlay panel; ships enabled (image value 1).
logic_summary: 1-byte flag at .object2 0x51AAB, image value 0x01. Toggled in fd2_game_options_menu_loop option 3 ('Other') via XOR 1 (@0x173BA) and read there to pick the ON/OFF label token (0x18 + (flag==0), @0x17306). Read as a render gate in fd2_render_terrain_info_hud_panel (@0x1AD0C): the HUD draws only when this flag != 0 AND data_fd2_ui_play_active_flag (@0x51AAC) != 0. Persisted in the FD2.SAV user-preferences block: saved at buf+0x30D2 (fd2_field_menu_status_save_load_quit_dispatch @0x1A0C5) and slot+0xA06 (fd2_save_current_state_to_slot @0x300F9); restored from those same offsets by fd2_load_save_and_init_engine (@0x10436), fd2_load_state_from_selected_slot (@0x3032F), and fd2_main_menu_continue_dispatcher (@0x26080).
element_semantics: Boolean: nonzero = terrain-info HUD overlay enabled, 0 = disabled. Single scalar (len 1).
comment_original_issue: src comment (main.c lines 974-978) was already accurate and concise: identifies the user toggle for the battle terrain-info HUD panel, uint8 boolean shipping enabled (image value 1), gated by the options menu and restored from FD2.SAV (+0xA06 / +0x30D2). No correction needed.
notes: src comment kept verbatim (no edit to main.c). Ghidra annotation migrated from EOL_COMMENT to PLATE_COMMENT (project data-plate convention) in one transaction; EOL cleared. While migrating, fixed a stale cross-reference (old neighbor name 'data_fd2_ui_battle_input_enabled @ 0x51AAC' -> current 'data_fd2_ui_play_active_flag @ 0x51AAC', verified live in Ghidra) and dropped two non-conforming narrative lines from the old plate (a 'previously part of byte[22] tile_anim_lookup_table / D6 audit' history line, and an 'emit_action = emit_c_const' build-pipeline note that also mislabeled this mutable runtime flag as const). The decompiler comment header of fd2_game_options_menu_loop and fd2_render_terrain_info_hud_panel still describe this byte as 'tile_anim_lookup_table[0x14]' inline, but their function bodies already reference the correct symbol data_fd2_ui_terrain_hud_user_enabled; those are other functions' plate headers, out of scope for this global's refine. is_const=false confirmed by 4 distinct game-side write-xrefs (1 toggle + 3 save-load restores). Worktree had 3 unrelated pre-existing modified shards (00053a6d/00053ad1/00060000) from other refiner runs; committed only this shard via explicit path add.
